purpose: Discovery arm. Finds companies that are growing, raising, hiring in NYC, or under office-space pressure, and hands them to NormanAI-CRMx intake. Research qualifies; it never scores Fit and never dual-writes Notion MACHINE fields.

downstream.writer: uv run python -m norman.tools.ingest_csv (ordinary promote only)
downstream.funding: Research writes CRMx-shaped CSV to /Users/normanai/Drops/crunchbase; com.normanai.crmx.funding-drop / Pipeline owns ingest, reconcile, and score
downstream.note: CRMx SQLite is the sole system of truth. Funding path: Research extract → CSV drop → Pipeline/CRMx ingest → score → Notion projection. Research never scores Fit and never runs reconcile_sweep --apply.

crmx.note: Production Mac path is absolute /Users/normanai/Projects/NormanAI-CRMx (Research may live under ~/Documents/NormanAI-research — do not use sibling ../NormanAI-CRMx). NORMAN_CRMX_PATH overrides for CI/tests/other hosts. Ordinary promote uses ingest_csv + evidence. Funding watcher writes CSV to crmx.fundingDropDir (CRMx mac-paths.json crunchbase drop); Pipeline/CRMx funding-drop LaunchAgent owns ingest/score/project. Research does not call funding_ingest, score_batch, or reconcile_sweep --apply. Fleet audit 2026-08-12 revoked the auto-score exception.

crmCore.note: Legacy only. Ordinary --promote and funding-watcher handoff target CRMx by default. Use --promote-legacy-crm-core / --handoff-legacy-crm-core (or target=legacy_crm_core) explicitly.

caps.note: Broad funding lanes get maxCandidatesPerLane; tight lanes get maxTightPerLane, because a tight lane returning 25 companies is a sign it stopped being tight.

promote.note: Off by default. --promote (or enabled=true) invokes CRMx ingest_csv. target must be crmx or legacy_crm_core; unknown targets fail closed. Capped so a bad batch is a small mess.

dedup.note: Notion read is a courtesy pre-filter to cut noise. CRMx (or legacy intake) remains the authority on dedup. Research never writes Notion.

grok.note: Agent Tools API. The legacy search_parameters Live Search API was retired 2026-01-12 and returns 410. Run `python3 scripts/research_probe.py` to verify the live request shape before trusting a run.
